I ran an initial usage and top-up check on the two accounts Alex provided. Notes below (summary attached):
- pilot.search@streamline.ai: used promo-DEC24, received 50k top-up on 2025-12-18, moderate bursty usage with a spike on 2026-01-05.
- pilot.sum@streamline.ai: requested and received a 50k extension on 2026-01-10.
- There's evidence of a third account (sandbox.streamline+1@gmail.com) that received credits via an earlier trial-request flow (different contact email).

Risk signal: three active trial/top-up events across related accounts inside a 45-day window. Per policy, multiple top-ups across related accounts require escalation for manual review. I attached the CSV export of token usage and the fraud-check-summary PDF.

Attachment: trial-usage-202601.csv; fraud-check-summary.pdf

Recommended next steps:
1) Pause automatic top-up eligibility for the related accounts until we confirm procurement intent.
2) Offer a single conditional promo of up to 100k tokens consolidated to one account once procurement confirms PO or exec sign-off.
3) If Marketing/sales want to grant an exception, get sign-off from Revenue Ops or legal and require billing contact + SSO onboarding.

Diego — can you coordinate with Alex on procurement timing and whether they can consolidate under one account? If this looks like a coordinated attempt to circumvent policy we should decline and suggest a paid pilot.
